text: Program Description This program is a 4 year(8 semester) program. For the first 3 semesters, students studyin TongjiUniversity. For the 4th to 7th semesters, studentscan choose to continue studying in Tongji University or studyinga double degree at the University of New South Wales in Australia. For the 8th semester,students of the both optionsstudyin Tongji University. Applicants who wish to apply for thedouble degree program shouldindicate in the application materials. Dual-degree graduates will receive undergraduate degreesfrom two universities and can take the Architects Professional Qualification Examination in China and Australia and other Commonwealth countries. Main courses: Art Modeling (1), Art History (2), Design Introduction (2), Design Basics (6), Art Modeling (2), Architectural Mechanics (4), History of Architecture (2), Introduction to Architecture (2), Architectural Design (1) Architectural Design Basics (6), Artistic Modeling Practice (4), Historical Environmental Records (4), Computer Graphics (2), Building Structures (4), Urban Reading (2), Architectural Generation Principles (2) , Architectural Design (2), Architectural Design (6), Building Information Modeling, Architectural Design (3), Architectural History and Theory (3), Architectural Design (4), Structure and Construction (2), Environment and Architecture ( 2) Architectural design (5), Architectural history and theory (2), Architectural design (6), Building regulations, Architectural disaster prevention (2), Vocational education for architects (2), Graduation designDegree conferred: Bachelor of Architecture Engineering from Tongji University. Students of the dual degree program also conferred a Bachelor of Science degree in Architecture from the University of New South Wales.
